nodes.label: BTC Market Mood — multi-timeframe mood verdict product
nodes.rationale: Exists because reading multi-timeframe confluence on existing tools is either ugly-utilitarian (TradingView) or dumbed-down; success = trader trusts it at a glance and reaches for it over TradingView for a mood/confluence read.

nodes.label: Primary Persona: Active Crypto Trader
nodes.rationale: Default persona the surface optimizes for first: reads mood across six timeframes in under a second, values speed/density/trust over hand-holding.

nodes.label: Design Principles: density with composure, depth serves data, motion with intent
nodes.rationale: Every element must earn trust; cinematic/motion effects must encode real signal (volume, volatility regime, a flip) or be cut; mood verdict legible in under one second.

nodes.label: Anti-references: neon crypto-bro, generic SaaS dashboard, TradingView flatness, glassmorphism
nodes.rationale: Rejects casino aesthetics and hero-metric SaaS templates; keeps TradingView's information richness while rejecting its utilitarian flatness — density with composure and depth.
